explanation: `Ideal.padicPow` is the library's own definition: an ℤ_p-power action on the principal units of an I-adically complete ring. The theorem says that raising to the power 0 gives 1. It follows directly from the library's own `padicPow_laws`, so all of its content lies in the library's definitions. Mathlib has no ℤ_p-exponentiation of principal units in a general adic ring, so no Mathlib declaration states this result. I did not search Mathlib, because the statement is entirely about this library-specific construction.
